info.name: Event Management API
info.description:
# Event Management API

Base URL: `{{base_url}}` (default `http://localhost:5000`).

## Runner setup
1. Run migrations and `python seed.py`; this creates `admin@example.com` / `Admin@123` and default categories.
2. Run **Admin Login**, **Create Organizer**, **Organizer Login**, **Create Category**, **Create Event**, **Publish Event**, **Create Registration**, then **Verify Payment** in that order. Scripts persist returned UUIDs and order IDs into the active environment.
3. Admin routes require `{{admin_token}}`; organizer routes require `{{organizer_token}}`; public routes need no token.

All routes and payload fields were extracted from Flask blueprints under `backend/app/routes`. Error responses raised by the service layer have the shape `{ "error": "..." }` (typically 404, 409, or 422). No file-upload endpoint exists, and payments are an internal simulation rather than an external gateway.

request.description: Unauthenticated root route defined in `backend/run.py`. Success 200: `{ "message": "Event Management API is running" }`.
Authenticates an ACTIVE admin. Success 200: `{ "access_token": "<jwt>", "actor_type": "admin" }`. Error 422: `{ "error": "Invalid email or password" }`.
Authenticates an ACTIVE organizer. Success 200 returns JWT. Error 422: `{ "error": "Invalid email or password" }`.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('organizer_token', json.access_token); }

request.description: Role-dispatched login. `actor_type` must be `admin` or `organizer`. Success 200 returns access token; invalid actor type/credentials returns 422.

Password must contain at least 8 chars, lowercase, uppercase, and number; phone must be 10–15 accepted characters. On success its test also logs in and stores `organizer_token`, so the runner can continue. Duplicate email returns 409; if rerunning, use the already-successful Organizer Login request.

exec: pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('base_url') + '/auth/organizer/login', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.environment.get('organizer_email'), password: pm.environment.get('organizer_password') }) } }, (err, response) => { if (!err && response.code === 200) pm.environment.set('organizer_token', response.json().access_token); });

item.name: Public Events, Bookings & Payments
item.description: No authorization header. Create Registration script saves registration_id, payment_id and order_id.

request.description: Lists only PUBLISHED, non-archived events sorted by start_datetime.
All populated filters are ANDed: title, city/location, category/category_id, type, organizer, keyword (exact array tag), date or date_from/date_to ISO. Success array; invalid date returns 422.

response.name: Error
response.body: {"error":"date must be a valid ISO-8601 datetime"}

request.description: Only PUBLISHED/non-archived event is visible. Success includes current fees; draft/archived/missing becomes 404.
Requires active, unexpired coupon and public event. seat_count must be >0. Success returns discount, subtotal, final_amount.
Creates PENDING/RESERVED booking, reserves seats atomically for 15 minutes, optionally redeems coupon, and creates simulated payment order. Event must be published/open.
Public booking detail. Adds payment_id/order_id if payment exists. Success 200; missing 404.
Creates or returns simulated payment order for registration. Success stores payment_id/order_id.
Simulates payment success; confirms registration, generates receipt, updates event/organizer/category counters. It is idempotent for an already successful payment.
Use only with a separate pending registration: marks payment FAILED, registration FAILED/EXPIRED and releases reserved seats.
Gets payment/receipt record by UUID. Success 200; missing payment 404.
